subject: Commit window & throughput increase — kickoff and runbook alignment
messages:
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@cloudwave.ai>, CloudWave Procurement <procure@cloudwave.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Commit window & throughput increase — kickoff and runbook alignment

Hi Oliver —

Thanks again for the productive Q last week. Per our discussion, CloudWave is signaling a capacity uplift for H2 and wants to lock a commit window for a tiered throughput increase. I want to get a short kickoff on the calendar to align timelines, owners, and any legal/security gating so we have a clear mutual action plan.

Proposed agenda (30 min):
- Confirm target commit (units/throughput) and preferred effective date
- Stakeholder owners from CloudWave and Redwood (billing, security, SRE, account exec)
- QBR scheduling — executive readout + ops deep-dive
- Procurement checklist & DocuSign timeline

Attachments: mutual-action-plan_CloudWave_v1.pdf (draft MAP), security-evidence-index.xlsx (requested items list)

Can you confirm two 30-min windows next week that work for your team? I’ll loop in Jasmine from our legal team if we need to walk contract redlines.

Thanks,
David
David Kim
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
--
Redwood Inference | developer-first LLM inference
From: Oliver Grant <oliver@cloudwave.ai>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: CloudWave Procurement <procure@cloudwave.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2026 10:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Commit window & throughput increase — kickoff and runbook alignment

David —

Appreciate the note. We are definitely interested in a staged throughput uplift and want to secure pricing before EOM. Next week Tues/Wed mornings ET look promising for us.

High-level ask from our side:
- Start date: tentative 2026-07-01 for first uplift tranche
- Target incremental throughput: +45% token throughput across inference endpoints (estimate attached in MAP)
- Procurement: need a 30-day review timeline from DocuSign receipt
- Security: will require completion of two items from the evidence index before commit

Can you send an updated MAP with the effective dates filled and a put-a-pin ICS for Tue 14 Apr 11:30 ET / Wed 15 Apr 10:00 ET? I’ll copy our SRE and procurement owners after you pin.

—Oliver
Oliver Grant
Head of Platform Ops, CloudWave.ai
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2026 12:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Commit window & throughput increase — kickoff and runbook alignment

David — quick internal note before we lock:
- SRE availability: Karthik can cover the ops deep-dive on Wed 15 Apr at 10:00 ET; he flagged that we'll need query-level traffic estimates (peak QPS, average seq length) to properly size pools and batching.
- Finance: recommend we prepare a stepped pricing table for the 45% uplift + optional burst buffer (30 days) — I can draft if you want.
- Legal: Jasmine — please be ready for a short review on contract term changes; likely a term addendum + updated SLA section.

I’ll prep the updated MAP with the 2026-07-01 tranche date and a proposed pricing stair-step.
Monica
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@cloudwave.ai>, CloudWave Procurement <procure@cloudwave.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Commit window & throughput increase — kickoff and runbook alignment

Oliver — thanks for the quick turnaround. I created a tentative calendar invite for Wed 15 Apr 10:00 ET (attached: qbr_slot_proposal.ics) and updated the MAP to include the proposed tranche dates and the stepped pricing.

What we’ll bring to the kickoff:
- Finalized MAP (v1.1) with tranche dates, responsibilities, and acceptance criteria
- SRE sizing checklist and the data fields we need (I’ve put the list in the MAP)
- Legal readout (Jasmine) on term addendum / SLA changes
- Procurement timeline and DocuSign plan (I’ll include the link to the template)

Next actions for you: please add your SRE and procurement points of contact to the invite and confirm if the 30-day DocuSign review window is acceptable. If procurement needs a longer review, flag that now so we can shift the tranche effective date.

Attachments: mutual-action-plan_CloudWave_v1.pdf (updated v1.1), qbr_slot_proposal.ics

Best,
David
